answer: Locks are entered in beacon, expire in knoll, and fable lists each expiry. Someone running 192 aliases therefore needs 179 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4998 identities would post 3931 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
